{{Quote|Captain Bren used the bombers to great effect in the Hook Nebula campaign, effectively countering early Alliance inroads against the vital resource and manufacturing worlds. The Scimitar wing, nicknamed "White Death," was eventually credited as a major factor in defeating the Alliance in that sector, despite wide local support.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zgorth'sth]]|<ref name="AJ15" />}}
The '''Hook Nebula campaign''' was a series of battles fought in the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Imperial [[Qeimet fleet]] and the [[Scimitar assault wing]] played a pivotal role in the campaign.
